newsitem.title: USA: Dow adds to gains, Nasdaq languishes.
newsitem.headline: Dow adds to gains, Nasdaq languishes.

text.p: The Dow industrial average rose after opening lower on Tuesday, but the Nasdaq composite index remained weak as technology stocks suffered.
The Dow was trading up around 26 points at 7316, after hitting an intraday low of 7254. Nasdaq, heavily weighted with technology stocks, was down 10 points at 1395.

Cautious investors took profits in technology stocks, particularly disk drive makers and networkers, after Seagate Technology Inc and Cabletron Systems warned their quarterly earnings would be below analysts' estimates.
The Dow was boosted by investors seeking quality names.
